mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a cool 46 degrees at Verona Community Park with a full moon visible. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation invites you to provide feedback on the US 18/151 Corridor Study. You can attend an in-person meeting on November 18 at Mount Horeb High School or a virtual session on November 19 to review design concepts.

It is a busy time in town! Today you can enjoy Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to more trivia at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory, live music at Paddy Mac's, and yoga at Insight Wellness.

Regarding local activity, on October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a 40-year-old Verona man who had been passed out behind the wheel; he was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist, a delicious treat to start your week. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy.
